title: YamlSigilSignature.v1alpha1
description: Strict and SignatureStrict YAML-form schema for the YamlSigilSignature.v1alpha1 signature document. This schema validates the parsed YAML signature document object; byte-level artifact decomposition and Verification's YAML signature-carrier safety requirements are specified outside JSON Schema. Before applying this schema, every conformance profile rejects carriers over 16,384 octets and duplicate known mapping keys, disables application-defined tag constructors, and enforces implementation-documented hard parser-resource limits. Permissive decoders apply the declared constraints to known fields but do not apply this schema's additionalProperties rule.

schema.description: YAML-form schema discriminator. The protobuf form omits this because the message type is the schema.

keyid.$comment: If present, keyid MUST be non-empty, MUST be at most 1024 UTF-8 octets, and MUST contain no U+000A or U+000D. JSON Schema maxLength counts Unicode code points, so the schema's 1024 is a loose approximation; the strict octet bound is enforced at decode (Signing rejects with INVALID_KEYID; Verification rejects as MalformedAttemptedSigned).
keyid.description: Optional caller-supplied lookup hint for the verification key. Mirrors proto optional string keyid. When present, MUST be 1..1024 UTF-8 octets and contain no CR or LF. Unsigned and never proof of signer identity.

algorithm.$comment: Closed enum of YAML-form alg wire strings (no ALGORITHM_ prefix). Maps to protobuf Algorithm per README.md 'The Signature Document' (ED25519_* -> ALGORITHM_ED25519_* enum 1, ECDSA_* -> ALGORITHM_ECDSA_* enum 2). ALGORITHM_UNSPECIFIED (protobuf 0) is not a valid alg here; unknown strings are schema-invalid and map to MalformedAttemptedSigned at verification. A schema-defined algorithm the verifier does not implement maps to SignedButAlgorithmUnsupported. Transcription treats the signature carrier as opaque bytes and does not read alg.
algorithm.description: Required algorithm identifier. Closed enum of YAML/JSON Schema wire spellings; see README.md mapping table to protobuf. Per-algorithm specifications live under README.md's 'The Signature Document' section.

signature.$comment: URL-safe base64 without padding per base64-requirements.md. Trailing-bits rejection is enforced at decode (Verification), not fully expressible in JSON Schema. The signature's decoded length is algorithm-specific (a fixed 64 octets, i.e. 86 base64url characters, for both v1alpha1 algorithms) and is enforced at the verification stage, not by this pattern, which constrains only the URL-safe alphabet and base64 grouping. The empty string is allowed here because empty bytes are wire-representable in the protobuf form; Verification rules reject empty decoded signature octets separately. Transcription treats the signature carrier as opaque bytes and does not read signature octets.
signature.description: Required base64-encoded signature octets for the YAML form (URL-safe, unpadded). Mirrors proto bytes signature; empty octets are schema-representable but invalid under later verification semantics.
